def evaluate(board):
    # disc sum
    score = 0
    weights = [10,10,12,12,12,10,10]
    for row in board:
        for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
            if cell == 1:
                score += weights[col_idx]
            elif cell == -1:
                score -= weights[col_idx]
    # line bonuses
    score += run_bonus(board, 1) * 2
    score -= run_bonus(board, -1) * 2
    return score
